_comment: PROGRESSION-VISIBLE (docs/prompts/73, D76). Every number the progression feed's presenters read: how close to a milestone counts as 'near', how long a tick / near pulse / moment banner lives, how two moments collapse, where the banner sits inside the safe area, and which sound cue a moment plays. Read by scripts/creatures/progression_feed.gd::config(); nothing else parses this file. ALL TUNABLE.
_comment_near: Per bond task: how many units short of the target counts as 'near' -- the party strip pip starts its slow pulse and the Team screen row says what is left. Keys are the task field names bond_milestones.json uses. `xp_fights` is the XP version: a creature is near a level when the XP still needed is at most this many level-matched wild wins' worth (progression.gd::xp_award_for at the creature's own level).
_comment_tick_verbs: The one word the party strip's bond tick shows after '+bond ·', per task. Past tense, what the player just did with the creature.
_comment_distance_tick_m: Distance is credited on every half-second discovery poll in fractions of a metre; a tick on each of those would never stop flickering. One bond_credit per this many metres crossed instead (the near/milestone checks still run on every credit).
_comment_durations: Seconds. tick: how long a '+bond · fed' flick shows on the party strip (<= 1s per prompt 73 §2.2). near_pulse: one full slow pulse period on a near pip/sliver. moment: how long the HUD banner holds. moment_collapse: two moments within this window share one banner. moment_cooldown: gap after a banner before the next one may show.
_comment_banner: The moment banner's slot on the authored 1920x1080 canvas (canvas_items / expand stretch, so the canvas grows to 1920x1200 on the Ally). top/height in canvas px; width centred. safe_area_fraction is the overscan margin every edge must clear (GATE3-HUD-SAFEAREA's own 5%): the HUD clamps the banner inside it whatever canvas it draws on. It sits under the region banner's slot (playground_hud.gd::REGION_BANNER_TOP 120 + 48) so the two top-centre cards never overlap, and well above the combat HUD's centre outcome line.
_comment_sound_cues: Cue ids per moment kind, resolved through data/config/audio.json's `progression` block to a generated sfx file (tools/audio/gen_sfx.py). An empty string is silence.
_comment_max_events: How many feed events the log keeps. Presenters read by sequence number and never drain, so this only bounds memory; 64 is far past anything one fight produces (five creatures x two events).
